title: “Roll to Me” by Del Amitri
text: "Roll to Me" is a song by Scottish pop rock band Del Amitri, released in June 1995 by A&M Records as the third single from their fourth studio album, Twisted. The song became their biggest hit in the United States when it reached number 10 on the Billboard Hot 100 chart.

title: “Scream / Childhood” by Michael Jackson and Janet Jackson
text: "Scream" is a song by American singers and siblings Michael and Janet Jackson. It was released as the lead single of Michael Jackson's ninth studio album, HIStory: Past, Present and Future, Book I.

title: “Freek'n You” by Jodeci
text: "Freek'n You" is a song by American R&B group Jodeci recorded for their third album, The Show, the After Party, the Hotel. It was released as the album's first single in June 1995, by Uptown and MCA Records.

title: “I Wish” by Skee-Lo
text: "I Wish" is a song written and performed by American rapper Skee-Lo. It was released on April 10, 1995, via Scotti Brothers Records as the lead single from the rapper's debut studio album of the same name.

title: “Believe” by Elton John
text: "Believe" is a song by British musician Elton John and lyricist Bernie Taupin, performed by John. It was the first single from his 24th studio album, Made in England, and was released on 20 February 1995.

title: “Carnival” by Natalie Merchant
text: "Carnival" is a song written and produced by American singer-songwriter Natalie Merchant and was the lead single from her debut solo album, Tigerlily. In the lyrics, the protagonist describes a street scene as a carnival.
